title: Map belief indices onto the maze
description: You connect flat state indices to free cells in a grid image.

steps.description: You flatten row i and column j with i*W+j. divmod reverses that mapping into a row and column.
You mark zero-valued grid cells as free and extract their flat indices. The recording reports 28 free cells out of 35 positions.

steps.question: What values appear at wall positions in the returned belief image?
steps.answer: They remain zero. The assignment copies belief entries only where free_mask is true.

steps.description: You return an H by W image containing the free-cell beliefs. The helper uses the existing H, W, and free_mask to place those values.
